title: QuickStatus.dev analytics beacon, version 1
description: The body qs.js POSTs to the collector as text/plain. Every field is listed in PAYLOAD.md.

s.description: Site id from the script tag (data-site).

u.description: Page URL. The query keeps only utm_*, ref and source.

w.description: Viewport width in CSS pixels (device type).

e.description: engage only: milliseconds the page was visible.

v.description: Custom events: value in minor units (cents).

c.description: Custom events: ISO 4217 currency of v.
